value.text:
Hi Sam, would you like to connect your Google Calendar? It lets your calendar join the kids' year that Hale keeps for the family. It's optional, and the link is only for you, not the rest of the group. Google may show an "unverified app" screen. That's a normal step for this connection and safe to pass: click Advanced, then continue. The link works for 15 minutes.
[[link]]
